messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: species name addition
parts:
Hi Amol,
can you please share some more details? 

- You did not identify your images yes, correct?
- please share the code you ran
- also, error messages or warnings, if any


Generally, appendSpeciesNames() is done after identifying species in images (either via drag and drop or image metadata). So you need to first identify species, then append the species names to the images. Please note, appending the species names is optional. You can do it if you want to have species names in the file names, but you don't need to. You can also continue with your analyses without adding species names to images, as long as your images are identified.

If you are unclear about the species identification process, have a look at vignette 2: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/vignettes/SpeciesIndividualIdentification.html

Please let me know if you have further questions.
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: species name addition
parts:
So you assigned the species tags as, for example, "Species|Spotted_deer", not "Spotted_deer"?

In other words, in your digiKam tag tree, does it look something like in the example in the vignette (the image here)? Or would the tags in the example read "Species|Leopard Cat", "Species|Spotted_deer" etc? If that was the case, you'd need to remove the "Species|" part in the tag manager and refresh the image metadata (using the "Write metadata to Images" button).
Also, when you use metadata tags, you can safely use spaces (Spotted deer instead of Spotted_deer).

But before you do anything, would you mind sharing a screenshot of your digiKam metadata tag tree please? Just to be sure I'm giving you the right advise. Or share a tagged sample image, then I can check the metadata.

Jürgen
